mechanism.claim: A causal one-day forecast from a bivariate Shanghai Composite/BTC return VAR carries macro information that Bitcoin incorporates with delay. Trade the forecast sign for twenty-four hours only when BTC is already in a high realized-variation regime.
mechanism.side: sign of the frozen causal one-step BTC return forecast; zero is ineligible

external_support.paper: Arain and Snudden (2026), When Are Statistical Forecast Gains Economically Relevant? Evidence From Bitcoin Returns
paper_fixed_facts: daily bivariate VARs generate real-time out-of-sample Bitcoin forecasts
the Shanghai Stock Exchange predictor has stable directional accuracy during large Bitcoin moves
the SSE long-short forecast strategy earns statistically significant excess profits at the ten-percent level
implementation_choices_not_claimed_as_re: VAR(1) with intercept estimated on a trailing 252 common-session window
24-hour BTC execution hold from ten minutes after the Shanghai close
causal BTC realized-variation rank gate of 0.65

mechanism.why_distinct: Repository collision scans found no Shanghai, SSE Composite, 000001.SS, or Shanghai-BTC VAR preregistration. Existing Asian relays use yuan, won, yen, or broad emerging-market volatility; existing stock relays use US-session SPY, Nasdaq, sector, or Russell information.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: The source paper identifies SSE as one of the predictors whose accuracy remains stable during large Bitcoin moves; the frozen implementation additionally requires causal BTC variation rank >= 0.65.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: A Shanghai cash-close forecast clock and an external Chinese-equity state are absent from Gross9 primitives.

features.sse_return: log(raw unadjusted Shanghai Composite close_t / close_previous_source_session)
features.btc_return: log(BTCUSDT 07:00 UTC five-minute open_t / 07:00 UTC five-minute open_previous_source_session)
features.common_rows: one paired row per exact Yahoo Shanghai session date; missing/nonpositive values are ineligible; no imputation
features.var: For each decision t, OLS-estimate a bivariate VAR(1) with intercept on exactly the immediately previous 252 finite paired rows, using rows (t-252..t-1) as dependent observations and their one-row lags; minimum 252 paired rows. Forecast BTC return one step from the current paired row.
features.forecast: BTC equation intercept + lag-BTC coefficient*btc_return_t + lag-SSE coefficient*sse_return_t
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open)) over 1,440 exact BTCUSDT 1m bars ending at but excluding 07:00 UTC
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 252 previous valid Shanghai-session BTC variations; minimum 126; current excluded; rank >= 0.65

clock.source_session: Yahoo 000001.SS raw unadjusted session date; Shanghai close fixed at 15:00 Asia/Shanghai (07:00 UTC)
clock.feature_available: 07:05 UTC after the completed Shanghai close and matched BTC bar
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: primary published SSE/BTC forecast economics and large-move stability plus exact repository absence

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, train/test/eval/final strict economics, then RV20 q90 audit; no predictor, lag, window, threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, model, or control repair
